text:
mira: Quick report: ran sirocco-v2 q4f canary on multilingual evals. Noticing a cluster of failures around thin/hair spaces (U+200A/U+2009) affecting Arabic ligatures and some JP ruby annotation spacing.

mira: Summary numbers: ja BLEU 23.1 (-3.0 vs fp32), zh BLEU 29.5 (-0.2), ar BLEU 17.4 (-4.7). Automated checks flagged high token-substitution rates when thin spaces sit next to punctuation or within ligature sequences.

mira: Short repro notes:
- fp32 + tokenizer v2 -> baseline OK
- q4f-int8 + tokenizer v2 -> regressions
- q4f-int8 + tokenizer v1 -> reduced regression (suggests tokenizer+quant interaction)

mira: Minimal AR example: Input: "البيت لان" (thin space between tokens)
Output int8: ligature split or replaced with ascii space in middle.

devon: We folded whitespace variants in the q4f remap table to save entries. If runtime remap didn't apply consistently upstream we could get id shifts for adjacent tokens.

ash: Also check KV-cache packing; int8 uses compact KVC layout with a remap table we added during onboarding. Off-by-one there would explain consistent neighbors breaking.

eva: Please upload 8 minimal repros (input, token ids, model output ids, logits). I'll add them to the harness and create a synthetic hair-space ligature test.

mira: Uploading traces + token dumps to S3 now; will post link in thread.

kai: @eval-bot run compare: sirocco-v2 fp32 vs q4f focusing on hair-space and ligature slices. Token-level diff preferred.

eval-bot: compare-hairspace-1765560000 queued. Link: https://ci.redwood/sirocco/compare/1765560000

devon: Quick triage: try running q4f artifact with remap_passthrough=true and with kernel=fp32-emulate to isolate remap vs numeric packing issues.

mira: Will run both and report back (ETA ~60m).

eva: For mitigation, we should gate q4f canary on the new synthetic test and pin tokenizer v1 for q4f until remap is fixed.

ash: Agreed. Ops on standby for rollback if canary fails production.

eval-bot: compare finished: AR BLEU -4.6, JP BLEU -3.1, flagged 88/110 thin-space ligature anomalies. Detailed diffs uploaded. Link: https://ci.redwood/sirocco/compare/1765560000/results

mira: Thanks. Action items:
- mira: run remap_passthrough + fp32-emulate tests and upload traces (ETA 90m)
- devon: audit remap folding rules and compact table packing (ETA EOD)
- eva: add hair/thin-space ligature synthetic test and gate (ETA EOD)

kai: Keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
